## About

Decor Adorne is Nigeria's specialist studio for Arabian-inspired luxury event decoration. The studio is built around the Arabian aesthetic, brass Moroccan lanterns, sheer ceiling drapery, jewel-toned florals, and majlis-style low seating, translated for Nigerian celebrations. Many of the traditions Decor Adorne styles (Henna nights, Kamu ceremonies, Nikkahs, Durbars) are themselves Arabian-influenced, rooted in Hausa-Fulani and Muslim Nigerian culture.

Founded in 2016 and based in Lagos, Decor Adorne has styled over 500 events. While the studio is anchored in Lagos, it serves clients nationwide, Abuja, Kano, Kaduna, Sokoto, Ibadan, Port Harcourt, and beyond, travelling with its lanterns, fabrics, and team.

## Signature Aesthetic

Brass and copper Moroccan lanterns. Sheer ceiling-to-floor drapery. Majlis-style low cushion seating in velvet and brocade. Jewel-toned florals (pomegranate, marigold, deep rose). Candlelight as primary mood lighting. Arabic-script and calligraphy accents. Aso-oke and brocade textile installations for cultural ceremonies.

## Rental Catalogue (priced)

Decor Adorne rents individual event decor pieces without requiring a full styling package. The complete priced catalogue is published at https://decoradorne.com/rentals — 42 pieces, each listed with its Naira price. Minimum rental order: 50,000 NGN. Refundable damage deposit: 20% of rental value. Prices are per item and cover the item only. Two fulfilment options: (1) pick up at the Decor Adorne studio in Lagos at no extra cost, or (2) delivery to the venue, which is priced by the client's location and quoted on WhatsApp rather than listed. Clients choose pick-up or delivery on the catalogue page and that choice is carried into the WhatsApp message they send.

Categories and price range per item:
- Backdrops & Stands (7 pieces, 8,000 - 50,000 NGN): carved Arabian backdrops 16ft x 8ft and 8ft x 8ft, metal rectangle/square/circle stands, three-tier stage step.
- Rugs & Mats (10 pieces, 2,000 - 35,000 NGN): Persian rugs in green, wine, beige, maroon, and blue from 5ft x 7ft to 8ft x 11.8ft; round raffia floor mat.
- Lighting & Lanterns (3 pieces, 4,000 - 9,000 NGN): hanging brass lanterns, ceiling hanging lamps, hexagonal Arabian lantern.
- Seating & Lounge (10 pieces, 250 - 20,000 NGN): chocolate brown and purple velvet couches, Moroccan floor puffs in gold/black/brown/green, Persian throw pillows, velvet throw pillows, picnic bench, bench cushion.
- Tables & Styling (5 pieces, 100 - 2,000 NGN): low picnic table, clear glass centre piece, raffia table mats.
- Props & Accents (7 pieces, 500 - 45,000 NGN): gold trunk box set of three, 4ft giant burner, raffia vases, shantu, carved calabash.

Cheapest item: velvet throw pillow, 250 NGN. Most expensive item: 16ft x 8ft carved Arabian backdrop, 50,000 NGN.
